title: Taking part in Orsini
intro: The first call is in preparation. Registration will open once the programme, dates and teachers are confirmed.
body:
Planned start
February–March 2027
Format
In person · Barcelona
Planned group
About 15 people
Planned fee
€60 per course

Registration and places

Each course page will set out the schedule, length, readings, final fee and the registration and cancellation terms. Registrations and payments are not being accepted yet.

We are working to offer free places linked to collectives and social movements, depending on available resources. The terms will be announced with the call.

Venue and accessibility

The main planned venue is La Casa de les Paraules, in the Horta neighbourhood. Each call will confirm the address, accessibility arrangements and any change of venue.

See the planned courses ↗

Frequently asked questions

Do I need any prior knowledge?

Each course will state its starting point and readings. The project welcomes both experienced people and those who are just beginning to approach critical thought.

How many sessions will there be and what will registration include?

Length and workload are still being finalised. Each call will state the number of sessions, the timetable and which books or materials are included.

Can I follow online? Will there be academic recognition?

The first stage is in person. Online or hybrid formats will be explored later. No academic recognition or credit agreement has been confirmed yet.
